title: iPhone free for 6 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 6 min (since 05:12Z; released by fix-g0-box). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: g0-box (owner fix-g0-box; startable: P-164).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-g0-box takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: the phone test that this alarm names (P-164) already ran and passed; the next one (P-165) waits for a tool fix and its signed plan, now marked so.

What you need to do: nothing.
